pages.title: Command Framework and Application Lifecycle
pages.purpose: How the step binary boots and how commands register: main.go, internal/cmd/root.go, init()-based registration via cli-utils, blank-import enabling of commands and CAS backends, plugin lookup, error and panic handling, version injection.
instructions: Document internal/command/inject.go InjectContext middleware and CLIContextFromContext; error handling incl. STEPDEBUG behavior and panic handler; version/release date ldflags in Makefile and step.Version from cli-utils.
Document internal/plugin/plugin.go: step-<name>-plugin executables looked up in $(step path)/plugins and PATH, and Run usage (e.g. step-kms-plugin via internal/cryptoutil).

Explain registration: each command package has init() calling command.Register(cmd) from github.com/smallstep/cli-utils/command; groups are enabled by the blank imports at the bottom of internal/cmd/root.go (list them: api, base64, beta, ca, certificate, completion, context, crl, crypto, fileserver, oauth, path, ssh) plus CAS interface blank imports (cloudcas, softcas, stepcas).
Include a short change guide: steps to add a new top-level command (new package under command/, init + Register, blank import in internal/cmd/root.go, test, CHANGELOG entry).
Trace run(): os.Exit(run()) in cmd/step/main.go; run() defers panicHandler, calls step.Init() (cli-utils environment init), builds app via newApp(os.Stdout, os.Stderr).

pages.title: Repository Architecture and Ownership
pages.purpose: High-level map of the module github.com/smallstep/cli: directory ownership, key external dependencies, the two operating modes (online CA client vs embedded offline CA), and where behavior lives.
instructions: Cite exact dependency versions from go.mod: urfave/cli v1.22.17, smallstep/certificates v0.30.2, smallstep/cli-utils v0.12.2, smallstep/linkedca v0.26.0, go.step.sm/crypto v0.89.0.

Describe module layout: cmd/ (entrypoint), command/ (urfave/cli v1.22.17 command groups), internal/ (private helpers: cmd, plugin, sshutil, cryptoutil, kdf, cast, crlutil, sliceutil, command), utils/ (shared client library incl. cautils), flags/, token/, pkg/bcrypt_pbkdf, integration/, packaging dirs (systemd, docker, debian, powershell), docs/.
Explain ownership boundaries per command/README.md: each command level in its own package, shared non-business logic at repo top level (flags, cli-utils).
Explain the two modes: talking to a remote step-ca over HTTPS (CaClient) vs --offline wrapping authority.Authority from smallstep/certificates.

pages.title: ACME and TPM Attestation
pages.purpose: The ACME client flow used by step ca acme certificate: order creation, HTTP-01 challenge serving in standalone and webroot modes, finalize, plus device attestation over TPM and EAB support.
instructions: Document ACMECreateCertFlow / ACMESignCSRFlow entry points and the acmeFlow options (withProvisionerName, withCSR, withSubjectSANs), client truststore handling in getClientTruststoreOption.
Document EAB (external account binding) subcommands in command/ca/acme/eab (add, list, remove, sigchild).

Document TPM device attestation in utils/cautils/tpm.go: doTPMAttestation, attestationClient, getAK, attestationStatement, EK selection, roots-file and insecure options, and how the attestation URI is parsed.

Document challenge serving: startHTTPServer, standaloneMode (default, listens :80, http-listen flag), webrootMode writing token files, serveAndValidateHTTPChallenge, authorizeOrder, finalizeOrder, getChallengeStatus.
Include a short change guide for extending ACME options or adding a challenge mode.

pages.title: CA Clients and Certificate Request Flows
pages.purpose: The core client library utils/cautils: CaClient interface and client construction, the option-based CertificateFlow for token-based signing, the embedded OfflineCA, the linkedca admin client, and the bootstrap flow that installs roots and default context.
instructions: Document CaClient methods: Sign, Renew, Revoke, Rekey, SSHSign, SSHRenew, SSHRekey, SSHRevoke, Version, GetRootCAs, GetCaURL and how NewClient/NewCaClient select online (API client) vs offline mode.

Document CertificateFlow: flowContext, functional Options (WithToken, WithProvisioner, WithSubject, WithSANs, WithTemplate, etc.), and the GetCertificate flow that builds a sign request; cite utils/cautils/certificate_flow.go.
Document OfflineCA: singleton wrapping authority.Authority from smallstep/certificates with a badgerDB-backed config, used for offline signing.
Document bootstrap: POST to bootstrap API, writing root to $STEPPATH/certs/root_ca.crt and config to $STEPPATH/configs/defaults.json, and context selection.
Document the linkedca AdminClient used by step ca admin for admin-provisioner authentication.
Include a focused change guide for adding a new flow option or a new CA API call to the client, with where each piece lives.

pages.title: Provisioner and One-Time Tokens
pages.purpose: How one-time JWT tokens and provisioner-issued tokens are built, parsed, and mapped to CA API audiences: the token package, TokenFlow interactive provisioner prompt, and per-provisioner token generators.
instructions: Document TokenFlow (utils/cautils/token_flow.go): interactive provisioner prompt, sign types (SignType, RevokeType, SSHUserSignType, SSHHostSignType, RekeyType, RenewType, SSHUserRenewType, SSHHostRenewType, SSHUserRekeyType, SSHHostRekeyType) and parseAudience mapping to /1.0/sign, /1.0/renew, /1.0/rekey, /1.0/revoke and /1.0/ssh/* endpoints.
Document TokenGenerator and generate* functions: JWK, OIDC, X5C, SSHPOP, Nebula, K8s service account, renewal tokens, and cloud identity provision tokens in token/provision/provision.go.
Document token.Parse / parse.go and how tokens attach to requests.
Document token.Token: DefaultIssuer step-cli, DefaultAudience https://ca/sign, validity constants, claim names (sha, sans, step, user, cnf) and options; cite token/token.go.
Note where audience/fingerprint derivation happens and flag uncertainty for behavior inside external packages.

pages.title: CA Command Group
pages.purpose: step ca subcommands for interacting with and managing a step-ca instance: init, bootstrap, token, certificate, renew (incl. daemon mode), rekey, revoke, sign, root/roots, federation, health, provisioner management, admin management, policy management, and ACME.
instructions: Document policy subcommands (step ca policy authority/provisioner/acme) with x509/ssh allow+deny actions in command/ca/policy/actions.
Document provisioner CRUD incl. webhook subcommands, and admin subcommands authenticated via the linkedca admin client (admin-provisioner, admin-subject, admin-password-file, admin-cert/admin-key).
Document renew's daemon mode: RenewAndPrepareNext, nextRenewDuration, after-renew hook (kill pid / exec cmd), and the systemd timer interplay.
Document the beta command group (command/beta) exposing beta ca acme APIs.

Enumerate the subcommands registered in command/ca/ca.go: health, init, bootstrap, token, certificate, rekey-certificate, renew-certificate, revoke-certificate, provisioner, sign-certificate, root, roots, federation, acme, policy, admin, plus the shared flags (acme, contact, http-listen, standalone, webroot, fingerprint, kid, host).
Include a focused change guide for adding a new step ca subcommand or a new provisioner subcommand.

pages.title: Certificate Command Group
pages.purpose: step certificate subcommands: offline creation via profiles and step-certificates templates, local sign/verify/bundle/inspect/lint, truststore install/uninstall, p12 conversion, renewal checks, and remote certificate retrieval.
instructions: Document create profiles (leaf, self-signed, intermediate-ca, root-ca, csr) and default validity constants, and the template/step-certificates rendering path with template data flags; cite command/certificate/create.go.
Document install/uninstall into OS trust stores and the offline flag behavior.
Document remote.go: TLS dialing to fetch peer certificates with urlPrefixes defaults (tcp/tls/https 443, smtps 465, ldaps 636), --roots, --server-name, --insecure.
Document sign/verify, bundle, inspect, lint (including CA bundle linting), fingerprint, p12, key, and needsRenewal (used by systemd renewals).
Include a focused change guide for adding a new certificate subcommand and for changing a create profile.

pages.title: Crypto Primitives Command Group
pages.purpose: step crypto subcommands for standalone cryptographic operations (keypairs, keys, JWK/JWS/JWE/JWT/JOSE, hash, KDF, NaCl, OTP, rand, winpe, change-pass) and the internal helper packages they rely on.
instructions: Document JWK create/inspect/show across RSA/EC/OKP/OCT, and how keys may be KMS URIs via internal/cryptoutil IsKMS/PublicKey and the step-kms-plugin Attestor interface.
Document KDF (internal/kdf: Scrypt, Bcrypt, Argon2i/Argon2id in PHC format) and the KDF subcommand; note safe defaults and the comment about future functional options.
Document otp (TOTP/HOTP), nacl (box/seal), rand, hash, winpe, and change-pass (bcrypt_pbkdf in pkg/bcrypt_pbkdf for Windows DPAPI-style passwords where evidenced).
Enumerate subcommands from command/crypto/crypto.go: change-pass, create-key-pair, jwk, jwt, jwe, jws, jose, hash, kdf, key, nacl, otp, rand, winpe.
Include a focused change guide for adding a new crypto subcommand, citing the package layout convention.

pages.title: SSH Certificate Subsystem
pages.purpose: step ssh subcommands and internal/sshutil: user and host SSH certificates, agent integration for login/logout, list/inspect, CA-driven ssh config generation, host checks, renewal/rekey/revoke, proxycommand, and SSH key parsing helpers.
instructions: Document config.go: rendering ~/.ssh/config from the step-certificates template fetched from the CA (template data, host list).
Document login flow: signing an SSH user certificate via the CA, adding the key to the SSH agent (sshutil agent helpers), and logout removing it.
Document renew/rekey with SSH token types and the needs-renewal check used by the ssh-cert-renewer systemd timer.
Document sshutil: NewCertSigner, ParseCertificate, PublicKey conversion, host/user certificate distinction, and key format helpers.
Document the step ssh subcommand set: certificate, check-host, config, fingerprint, hosts, inspect, list, login, logout, needs-renewal, proxycommand, rekey, renew, revoke.
Include a focused change guide for adding a new step ssh subcommand or extending sshutil.

pages.title: Configuration, Contexts, and Environment
pages.purpose: How the CLI locates its configuration: $STEPPATH layout, contexts (contexts.json, defaults.json, profile defaults), the global flags shared across commands, the --config file flag, and how contexts are injected into commands.
instructions: Catalog the shared flags in flags/flags.go by purpose: CA connection (CaURL, Root, Fingerprint if present, Context, ContextProfile, ContextAuthority, Offline, CaConfig), provisioner/admin auth (Provisioner, AdminProvisioner, AdminSubject, AdminPasswordFile, AdminCert, AdminKey), X5C/X5T/SSHPOP cert flags, key material (KTY, Size, Curve, Subtle), time bounds (NotBefore/NotAfter, CertNotBefore/CertNotAfter), output/behavior (Force, DryRun, Insecure, NoPassword, PasswordFile, Token, NoPager).

Document $STEPPATH (default ~/.step): certs/root_ca.crt, configs/defaults.json with ca-url/fingerprint/root, contexts.json; cite utils/cautils/bootstrap.go bootstrapAPIResponse and UseContext/WarnContext, and the example defaults.json in command/ca/ca.go description.
Document context subcommands (step context list/current/select/remove) and that they manipulate step.Contexts() from cli-utils.
Explain how flag values resolve to a context (flag override vs named context vs default) where evidenced; note uncertainty where resolution logic lives in cli-utils outside this repo.
Include a short change guide for adding a shared flag in flags/flags.go and wiring it into commands.

pages.title: Build, Test, and Change Guides
pages.purpose: How to build, test, lint, and release-prepare the project, plus focused change guides for representative maintenance tasks grounded in the Makefile and contributing docs.
instructions: Document Makefile targets: all (lint test build), ci (test build), build (bin/), test (gotestsum), lint, bootstrap; CGO_ENABLED=0 default, GOOS_OVERRIDE, version from GITHUB_REF or git describe, ldflags for version/build time.
Document docs/CONTRIBUTING.md requirements: fit the crypto toolkit scope, don't break existing functionality, issue tracking, and CHANGELOG.md update requirement for user-visible changes.
Document docs/local-development.md: make bootstrap for dev dependencies, make build, running tests, and the note about building for the host platform.
Document the command/README.md conventions: one package per command hierarchy level, registration via init()+Register, shared non-business code at top level, urfave/cli style guide.

Provide focused change guides: (1) add a new top-level command, (2) add a shared flag, (3) add a new crypto or certificate subcommand, (4) add an integration test, (5) update a provisioner token flow; each with the exact files to touch and how to validate (make test / make lint / targeted go test).
State uncertainty explicitly where a behavior is owned by external modules (cli-utils, certificates, go.step.sm/crypto).

pages.title: Distribution, Renewal, and Operational Integration
pages.purpose: Operational surface: systemd units and timers for automatic certificate and SSH certificate renewal, packaging (docker, debian, powershell), the fileserver command, shell autocomplete, scripts, and the integration test harness.
instructions: Document docker/ build (multi-stage, CGO_ENABLED=0 consistent with Makefile), debian packaging, and powershell install script; cite each.
Document step fileserver (serving a directory over HTTP for ACME webroot-style use) and shell completion/autocomplete generation.
Document the integration test harness: integration/main_test.go TestMain building the binary via make, and what integration/certificate_test.go, crypto_test.go, help_test.go cover.

Document the systemd units/timers: cert-renewer and ssh-cert-renewer units and how they pair with step ca renew --daemon / step ssh needs-renewal; cite systemd/README.md noting files are redirect targets in the files.smallstep.com S3 bucket.
Flag uncertainty about external release pipelines (GoReleaser referenced in Makefile) since the release config itself is not in this repo.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical start: prerequisites, building the step binary, first CA bootstrap, first certificate, SSH login, and running tests, with citations to Makefile and local development docs.
instructions: Cite Makefile targets and docs/local-development.md; mark anything not directly evidenced as uncertain.
Cover prerequisites (Go per go.mod), make bootstrap, make build producing bin/step, step version, step completion.

Show a first-run flow: step ca bootstrap --ca-url --fingerprint writing $STEPPATH/configs/defaults.json and root_ca.crt, then step ca token and step ca certificate, then step ssh login / step ssh config.
State clearly that this CLI is a client for the separate step-ca server (smallstep/certificates) and that offline mode embeds a CA via that library.
